descriptionFull: The gray-crowned rosy finch , or gray-crowned rosy-finch , ( Leucosticte tephrocotis ) is a species of passerine bird in the family Fringillidae native to Alaska, western Canada, and the north-western United States. Due to its remote and rocky alpine habitat it is rarely seen. There are currently six recognized subspecies. It is one of four species of rosy finches.
